theater: 雁門關外白道與涼州道北線

battle.name: 隋反擊突厥之戰
battle.theater: 雁門關外白道與涼州道北線
battle.brief: 開皇三年（583年）四月，隋文帝乘突厥內部分裂，分道出師反擊大可汗沙缽略可汗。五月，衛王楊爽於雁門關外白道大破之，沙缽略僅以身免，奔碻口；涼州道竇榮定在高越原數敗阿波可汗。同期長孫晟行離間之策，使兩汗互相猜忌。弓是此役裝備的骨幹，隋軍角弓與突厥騎射在峽道與沙磧中各有極限，卡面亞述長弓標示的正是複合弓技術的源頭譜系。

kit.name: 亞述長弓
kit.history: 亞述人靠弓和鐵的組合征服兩河流域。弓兵在車上射，車兵靠弓兵開路。

countries: 開皇三年（583年）四月起兵時，隋朝是剛完成南北統一、正在重建制度的中央集權帝國：同年罷諸郡、置州縣，把行政改為州縣兩級；兵制以府兵為骨架，宿衛與邊鎮由折衝府輪番充當，府兵平時耕田、戰時集結，行軍時由行軍元帥總督諸軍，各道行軍總管分道策應，後方由州縣徵丁轉輸糧秣。《隋書·高祖紀》記此役以衛王楊爽、河間王楊弘、上柱國豆盧勤、秦州總管竇榮定並為行軍元帥分道出師，通說為八路北伐；北線自太原、雁門直抵白道，西線自涼州出高越原，東線在幽州一線牽制，靈州、五原與沿邊屯田則是全軍的糧秣與馬匹基地。突厥方面是草原聯盟式的汗國：大可汗沙缽略可汗（攝圖）居中控弦，西面有達頭可汗（玷厥）自成一體，小可汗阿波（大邏便）與大汗之弟處羅侯各擁強兵，牙帳以盟誓與質子維繫各部從屬，兵員來自各部騎士，並有遊牧步兵與家屬隨營。583年前後汗國遭旱災與疫疾，畜群與口糧不足，部眾的向心力被內鬥吃掉；前一年大可汗曾盡發四十萬騎兵南入長城，掠走幽州、並州一線的鐵器與糧秣，把中原的弓材、箭鏃與農具一併帶回草原，補給的誘惑正是這一年再度南進的真正動力。
countriesEn: When the campaign opened in the fourth month of the third year of Kaihuang (583), the Sui was a centralised imperial state that had only just finished reunifying north and south and was in the middle of rebuilding its institutions: in the same year it abolished the commanderies and reorganised the administration into a two-tier system of prefectures and counties; the backbone of its military was the fubing militia, with the capital garrison and the frontier posts filled by rotation out of the zhechong fu, the fubing ploughing in peacetime and mustering in war; when an army went out, a 行軍元帥 (supreme field commander) held overall command, campaign commanders (行軍總管) in each circuit handled the parallel lines, and the prefectures and counties behind them levied labour to shift grain and equipment. The chronicle of Emperor Wen in the Sui Shu records that for this campaign the Prince of Wei Yang Shuang, the Prince of Hejian Yang Hong, the upper pillar-general Dou Luqin and the Qinzhou governor Dou Rongding were appointed together as 行軍元帥 and sent out by separate routes, and it is generally said that eight columns went north; the northern line ran from Taiyuan and Yanmen straight out to the White Way, the western line out of Liangzhou toward Gao Yuanyuan, the eastern line held the line at Youzhou, and Lingzhou, Wuyuan and the tuntian farms along the frontier were the base for the grain, fodder and horses of the whole army. The Turks on the other side were a steppe confederation shaped as a khanate: the great khan Shabulo (Shetuo) held the centre and the strings, with Tatuo khan (Diangjue) in the west running a line of his own, while the lesser khan Aboshi (Daluobian) and the great khan's brother Chuluohou each commanded strong bodies of men; the tented headquarters held the tribes in obedience through oaths and hostages, the soldiers came from the horsemen of each tribe, and nomadic footmen and their families moved with the camps. Around 583 the khanate was struck by drought and disease, herds and provisions fell short, and the cohesion of the tribes was being eaten away by internal rivalry; the year before, the great khan had turned out four hundred thousand riders, crossed the Great Wall, and carried off the iron and grain of the You and Bing circuits, taking Chinese bow staves, arrowheads and farm tools back to the steppe with them, and the pull of that plunder was the true engine behind the renewed southward move in 583.
people: 這一戰的關鍵人物，一半在朝堂，一半在牙帳。隋文帝楊堅是決策者：他在開皇三年四月下詔分道反擊，同時推行罷諸郡置州縣的體制改革，並採納了長孫晟「遠交而近攻、離強而合弱」的方略，把軍事壓力與外交分化並用；沙缽略遣使請和時，他允許北周千金公主改姓楊氏、改封大義公主，又拒絕把阿波可汗梆首示眾，理由是怕失遠人之心。長孫晟是此役最關鍵的執行者：北周大象年間他以使者身分送公主赴突厥，滯留一年，憑一箭貫雙雕的射術得可汗親愛，又與處羅侯結為心腹，歸隋後把汗國山川形勢與部眾強弱一一道出；開皇三年他在竇榮定軍中擔偏將，藉高越原的接戰向阿波使者陳說利害，使阿波留塞上、遣使入朝，挑動沙缽略抄其北牙、殺其母，阿波西奔達頭借兵十餘萬反攻，汗國自此由強轉弱。行軍元帥之中，衛王楊爽在白道擊敗沙缽略，秦州總管竇榮定在涼州道高越原數敗阿波；尚書省官員虞慶則在開皇四年以正使身分出使沙缽略，長孫晟為副使，勸可汗行拜詔之禮。草原一方，大可汗沙缽略是射術的行家，他曾令子弟貴人向長孫晟學射；處羅侯的兒子染干在開皇二年為長孫晟傳話，稱鐵勒將要夜襲牙帳，勸沙缽略早撤。
peopleEn: The decisive personalities of this war were half in the court and half in the tented headquarters. Emperor Wen of Sui, Yang Jian, was the man who decided: in the fourth month of the third year of Kaihuang he issued the orders for the counter-stroke by separate routes, pushed through the administrative reform that abolished the commanderies and set up prefectures and counties, and adopted the stratagem of Changsun Sheng, to keep distant friends close and attack the strong while joining the weak, using military pressure and diplomatic division at the same time; when Shabulo sent an envoy to ask for peace, he allowed the late Northern Zhou princess to take the surname Yang and be re-titled as the Grand Princess of Virtue, and he refused to have the lesser khan Aboshi's head displayed to the troops, on the ground that it would lose the hearts of those far away. Changsun Sheng was the man who carried the plan out: in the Daxiang years of Northern Zhou he had gone to the Turks as an envoy with the princess, had stayed a full year, and had won the khan's affection by shooting two eagles with a single arrow; he had also made Chuluohou a confidant, and after returning to the Sui he set out for the ruler the shape of the khanate's mountains and rivers and the strength of its tribes. In 583 he served as a subordinate general in Dou Rongding's army, and at Gao Yuanyuan he pressed the argument on Aboshi's envoys until Aboshi stayed on the frontier and sent an embassy to the Sui court, which goaded Shabulo into seizing his rival's northern camp and killing his mother; Aboshi fled west to Tatuo, borrowed more than a hundred thousand riders from him and turned back on Shabulo, and from that point the khanate went from strength to weakness. Among the field commanders, the Prince of Wei Yang Shuang defeated Shabulo at the White Way, and the Qinzhou governor Dou Rongding beat Aboshi repeatedly at Gao Yuanyuan on the Liangzhou road; a minister of the Department of State Affairs, Yu Qingze, went out to Shabulo as the senior envoy in the fourth year of Kaihuang, with Changsun Sheng as his deputy, and persuaded the khan to perform the ceremony of kneeling to receive the imperial decree. On the steppe side the great khan Shabulo was himself a master of the bow, and had once ordered his sons and nobles to learn archery from Changsun Sheng; the son of Chuluohou, Randan, carried Changsun Sheng's message in the second year of Kaihuang, telling Shabulo that the Tiele were about to strike his headquarters by night and urging him to withdraw early.
kits: 卡面這件亞述長弓並不是583年任何一方手上的實配兵器，這一點要說在前頭：亞述長弓是公元前七世紀亞述人用角、木、筋三層膠合而成的複合反曲弓，是兩河流域最早的一批複合弓標本，亞述人靠弓與鐵的組合建立起兩河帝國。它在這張卡上的意義是複合弓技術的源頭譜系：弓臂以角片承受拉力、木芯居中、筋背貼合，弦上的是短而重的箭，短程之內仍有破甲之力，弓兵可在車上射、車兵靠弓兵開路。落到583年，兩軍真正上手的是同一族技術的北方版本：隋軍用漢式角弓，角、筋、木三材合製，箭以竹木為杆、羽為尾，配臂弩與更強的蹋張弩；步兵持長槊、結方盾，披兜鍪與明光甲，騎兵掛槊佩環首刀，並以鐙馬護住騎士軀幹，帳幕、輜重車隊與橐駝把糧秣從靈州、五原運到白道，拒馬與鹿角用來封閉隘口。突厥的弓同樣是角骨反曲，配骨鏃與鐵鏃，札甲皮甲之外還有得自中原的鐵器，環首刀、長矛與標槍並用，氈帳與馬群隨營移動。弓在這一戰的位置因此十分清楚：隋軍靠槊陣正面頂住騎兵、靠弓弩覆蓋兩側坡地，突厥靠騎射擾亂與襲擊，但在白道那樣的峽道裡騎兵無處展開，射擊便成了浪費。
kitsEn: The Assyrian bow on the card face was not the issue in the hands of either side in 583, and that has to be said first: the Assyrian bow is a composite reflex bow made in seventh-century BC Assyria from horn, wood and sinew bonded in three layers, one of the earliest composite bow specimens from Mesopotamia, and the Assyrians built a riverine empire on the combination of the bow and iron. What the card stands for is the pedigree of composite bow technology: horn takes the tension, wood forms the core, sinew backs the belly, and the arrows on the string are short and heavy, still able to pierce armour at close range, with archers shooting from the wagons while the wagon troops advance behind the archers. By 583 the two armies actually held the northern version of the same family of technology: the Sui used Han-style composite bows of horn, sinew and wood, with bamboo-and-wood shafts and feathered fletching, and with hand crossbows and the stronger foot-tensioned crossbow; infantry carried long spears and rectangular shields, wearing helmets and bright armour, while cavalry took lance and ring-pommel sabre and used armoured caparisons to protect the rider's body, and tents, baggage wagons and camels carried grain from Lingzhou and Wuyuan out to the White Way, with cheval-de-frise and antler stakes sealing the defiles. The Turkic bow was likewise a horn-and-bone reflex, carrying bone and iron arrowheads; beside lamellar and leather armour they had iron taken from the Central Plain, and used ring-pommel sabres, long spears and javelins, with felt tents and herds of horses moving with the camp. The place of the bow in this war is therefore clear: the Sui used the spear line to take the charge head-on and used bows and crossbows to cover the slopes on both flanks, while the Turks relied on mounted archery to harry and to raid, but in a defile such as the White Way the horsemen had no room to deploy, and their shooting went for nothing.
tactics: 隋軍的戰法是分道齊進，逼突厥無法集中一處兵力。開皇三年四月，四路元帥同日發兵：白道一路自太原、雁門出，涼州一路自武威向西北，幽州與河套一路壓住塞內，使沙缽略既不能全力南下，也不能退守一地以待援手。五月白道會戰，隋軍在狹長峽道中以步騎混合的陣形封住谷口，前列長槊接住衝鋒，兩翼弓弩覆蓋坡面，把騎兵的衝力釘在峽道寬度之內；沙缽略大敗，僅以身免，奔至碻口，隋軍追出塞外才收兵。西線高越原一帶是瀚海沙磧，竇榮定率九總管、步騎兵三萬分隊輪番，以矢石消耗阿波可汗的騎兵，數戰數勝。而這一役真正決定勝負的戰術其實在帳幕之內：長孫晟以贈禮、使者與被俘者的傳話散布對方與隋交通的謠言，讓大可汗與小可汗互相猜忌，隋廷則退到局外，只冊封勝出的一方、資助敗退的一方，把兵力的消耗交給草原自己去承受。整條供給線的考驗同樣關鍵：春季出兵的糧道沿靈州、五原與涼州倉儲展開，車隊與橐駝的速度限制了大軍深入的可能，隋廷沒有把這場戰爭拖成一場持久消耗。
tacticsEn: The Sui plan was to advance by separate routes at the same time, so that the Turks could not concentrate their strength anywhere. In the fourth month of the third year of Kaihuang the four field commanders moved out on the same day: the White Way column from Taiyuan and Yanmen, the Liangzhou column out of Wuwei toward the northwest, the Youzhou and Hetao column pressing the inside of the frontier, so that Shabulo could neither throw his whole weight south nor fall back on one place and wait for help. At the engagement in the White Way in the fifth month the Sui closed the mouth of the gorge with a mixed formation of foot and horse, the front rank of long spears taking the charge, bows and crossbows covering the slopes on both wings, pinning the cavalry's impact inside the width of the defile; Shabulo was badly beaten, escaped with his life alone and ran to the Qikou, and the Sui pursued beyond the frontier before calling off the chase. On the western front at Gao Yuanyuan the ground was the sand and gravel of the desert; Dou Rongding, with nine commanders and thirty thousand foot and horse, fought in relay, spending arrows and stones on Aboshi's riders and winning several engagements. The tactic that really decided the war, however, was worked out inside the tents: by means of gifts, envoys and the talk of captives Changsun Sheng spread the rumour that the rival khan was in secret correspondence with the Sui, so that great khan and lesser khan began to suspect each other; the Sui court then stepped back out of the game, enfeoffing whichever side prevailed and aiding the side that failed, and left the bleeding to the steppe itself. The test of the whole supply line mattered just as much: the grain route of a spring campaign ran along Lingzhou, Wuyuan and the granaries of Liangzhou, and the speed of the wagon trains and the camels set a limit on how far the army could go, so the Sui court did not let the war degenerate into a war of attrition.
data: 這一役的數字在史書裡分歧很大，能確定的只有量級與時序。開皇三年四月分道出師，《隋書·高祖紀》列出的行軍元帥為衛王楊爽、河間王楊弘、上柱國豆盧勤、秦州總管竇榮定，通說為八路北伐。白道一戰，諸書只記沙缽略大敗、僅以身免、奔至碻口，斬獲數從數千到數萬不一，難以盡信；涼州道高越原，竇榮定所部為九總管、步騎兵三萬，數敗阿波可汗軍。前一年開皇二年可作對照：沙缽略率十餘萬眾南入塞，行軍總管達奚長儒以二千人迎戰而殺傷其萬餘人，李充部破突厥於馬邑，涼州總管賀婁子干破達頭於可洛峐；同年「悉發四十萬騎兵」一類數字應視為誇張，實際參戰兵力當遠少於此。時間軸可排：583年四月出兵、五月白道與高越原交戰、同年冬沙缽略遣使請和，584年遣虞慶則等出使並改封大義公主，585年七月沙缽略稱藩，587年四月沙缽略卒、處羅侯立為莫何可汗並生擒阿波，588年莫何死、都藍繼位，599年都藍敗亡、隋冊染干為啟民可汗，603年達頭可汗被隋軍擊敗。距離上，白道距雁門關數百餘里，涼州至高越原亦數百餘里，沙缽略自碻口北遁數百里才回到漠北牙帳。
dataEn: The figures for this campaign differ widely between the histories, and only the orders of magnitude and the sequence can be treated as certain. The armies went out by separate routes in the fourth month of the third year of Kaihuang, and the 行軍元帥 listed in the chronicle of Emperor Wen in the Sui Shu were the Prince of Wei Yang Shuang, the Prince of Hejian Yang Hong, the upper pillar-general Dou Luqin and the Qinzhou governor Dou Rongding, with eight columns going north by the general account. For the White Way, the histories record only that Shabulo was heavily beaten, escaped with his life alone and ran to the Qikou; the tally of enemy dead ranges from several thousand to tens of thousands and cannot be relied on. On the Liangzhou road at Gao Yuanyuan, Dou Rongding's force was nine commanders with thirty thousand foot and horse, and it beat Aboshi's khan several times. The previous year, the second of Kaihuang, gives a useful comparison: Shabulo brought more than a hundred thousand men over the frontier, and the campaign commander Daxi Changru met him with two thousand men and killed or wounded more than ten thousand of the enemy; the troops of Li Chong broke the Turks at Mayi, and the Liangzhou governor Helou Zigan broke Tatuo's men at Keluoai. The figure of four hundred thousand riders turned out in full in that same year should be read as an exaggeration, and the actual force in the field must have been far smaller. The sequence can be laid out as follows: the armies went out in the fourth month of 583; the fighting at the White Way and at Gao Yuanyuan came in the fifth month; in the winter of the same year Shabulo sent an envoy to ask for peace; in 584 the Sui sent Yu Qingze and others as envoys and re-titled the princess as the Grand Princess of Virtue; in the seventh month of 585 Shabulo declared himself a vassal; in the fourth month of 587 Shabulo died, Chuluohou was set up as the Mohe khan and took Aboshi alive; in 588 Mohe died and Dulun succeeded him; in 599 Dulun was destroyed and the Sui enfeoffed Randan as the Qimin khan; in 603 the khanate of Tatuo was defeated by Sui troops. On distances, the White Way lies several hundred li from the Yanmen pass, and Gao Yuanyuan is likewise several hundred li out from Liangzhou, and Shabulo had to flee several hundred li north from the Qikou before he reached his tented headquarters in the northern desert.
cause: 583年這場反擊，是開皇二年整整一年挨打之後的反應。開皇二年春，隋文帝方才立足，突厥大可汗沙缽略便藉「周家親也」的名分與北周宗女千金公主之請，集眾南侵，越過長城，攻陷臨榆關，掠取幽州、並州一線的鐵器、糧秣與馬匹；隋軍雖在馬邑、可洛峐等處屢挫其鋒，卻只能退守亭障、加固長城，北方邊患壓在剛建立的王朝頭上。轉機來自三方面。其一，583年前後草原連遭旱災疫疾，畜群與口糧不足，汗國的裂痕全面顯現，攝圖與阿波、達頭、處羅侯各懷異志。其二，隋朝在江南尚未動兵，國力尚能支撐一次大規模北征，文帝又恰在開皇三年推行州縣制、整頓府兵，行政與兵制的重整提供了調兵的餘裕。其三，滅陳需要一個安靜的北疆；開皇三年冬隋已分道伐陳，高寶寧在江淮一線被解決，北方若再拖住主力，南線的收官就無從談起。於是文帝把主力壓向北線，分道出師所求的不是一舉殲滅，而是打散汗國、逼出內亂。
causeEn: The counter-stroke of 583 was the answer to a full year of being hit about during the second year of Kaihuang. In the spring of that year, with Yang Jian only just established on the throne, the great Turkic khan Shabulo used the pretext that he was a kinsman of the Zhou house, together with the request of the late Northern Zhou princess, to gather his people and drive south: he crossed the Great Wall, seized the Linyu pass, and carried off the iron, grain and horses of the You and Bing circuits. The Sui army did check him at places such as Mayi and Keluoai, but it could do no more than retire behind the barrier forts and strengthen the wall, and the northern front sat on top of a dynasty that had only just been founded. The opening came from three directions. First, around 583 the steppe was hit by drought and disease in succession, herds and provisions were short, and the cracks in the khanate showed plainly, with Shetuo, Aboshi, Tatuo and Chuluohou each nursing a separate grievance. Second, the Sui had not yet committed its strength in the south, the treasury could still support a large northern expedition, and the emperor was at that very moment carrying out the prefectures-and-counties reform and reorganising the fubing, so that the administrative and military overhaul left room to move troops. Third, the conquest of Chen required a quiet northern frontier; in the winter of 583 the Sui had already gone out by separate routes against Chen and Gao Baoning had been settled on the Jiang-Huai line, and if the north kept tying down the main force, the southern campaign could never be closed out. So the emperor put his weight on the northern line, and what the advance by separate routes sought was not the destruction of the khanate but its disintegration and a forced civil war.
impact: 這一役的影響，遠大於白道與高越原兩處戰場本身的勝負。第一，北方邊患基本解除。沙缽略在開皇四年受封大義公主、五年稱藩、歲貢不絕，隋朝由此騰出手來全力南征，開皇八年冬大舉伐陳，開皇九年滅陳，589年統一南北；可以說沒有583年的北線勝勢，就沒有589年的南線結局。第二，草原權力被重切。沙缽略自強轉弱，阿波一系覆滅，達頭支系在西面坐大，隋朝則在汗國內部扶植出附隋的客戶：染干在開皇十七年娶安義公主、南遷度斤舊鎮，開皇十九年被冊為啟民可汗，隋朝在河套為他築金河、定襄二城；啟民部眾與長城內的州縣雜居，草原與內地的往來由間歇的掠奪轉為常設的通道，這正是唐代李靖、蘇定方北伐所直接繼承的格局。第三，制度層面，開皇三年罷諸郡置州縣、兵農合一的府兵制走向成熟，使隋廷有能力在一年之內同時在南北兩條戰線調兵，這套體制一直用到隋末，也是唐軍的底子。
impactEn: The effects of this campaign reached far beyond the outcomes of the two battlefields themselves at the White Way and at Gao Yuanyuan. First, the northern front was substantially cleared. Shabulo was granted the title of the Grand Princess's husband in 584, declared himself a vassal in 585, and sent regular tribute; the Sui was thereby freed to concentrate on the south, raised a great expedition against Chen in the winter of 588, destroyed Chen in 589 and reunited north and south. Without the northern success of 583 there would have been no southern conclusion in 589. Second, the steppe's balance of power was cut into new pieces. Shabulo went from strength to weakness, Aboshi's line was extinguished, Tatuo's branch grew powerful in the west, and the Sui picked out a client inside the khanate: Randan married the An'yi princess in the seventeenth year of Kaihuang and moved south to the old seat at Dujin, was enfeoffed as the Qimin khan in the nineteenth year, and the Sui built the cities of Jinhe and Dingxiang for him in the Ordos loop; the people of Qimin mingled with the prefectures and counties inside the wall, and the intercourse between steppe and interior changed from intermittent plunder into a standing channel, a pattern the Tang campaigns of Li Jing and Su Dingfang directly inherited. Third, at the level of institutions, the abolition of the commanderies, the setting up of prefectures and counties, and the arrival of a fully developed fubing militia that farmed in peace and fought in war gave the Sui court the capacity to move troops on two fronts, north and south, within a single year; that system ran until the end of the Sui and became the foundation of the Tang armies.
result: 開皇三年這場反擊沒有把沙缽略打滅，結果是另一種形式的結束：打得他請和，逼得汗國內部自己打起來。軍務上，白道一戰隋軍大捷，沙缽略僅以身免、奔碻口，涼州道竇榮定在高越原數敗阿波，可汗本人第一次承認中原的兵威；外交上，隋廷沒有乘勝追入漠北擒帥，而是轉為羈縻，583年底沙缽略遣使請和、公主自請改姓，584年改封大義公主，585年七月正式稱藩，北方換來十六年沒有大規模南侵的安寧，隋朝得以傾國力南下。內部則是草原的崩解：沙缽略抄了阿波的北牙、殺了他的母，卻因此換來達頭十餘萬騎兵的反擊，收聚散卒數萬而連勝；587年沙缽略死，處羅侯即位並生擒阿波，588年莫何可汗中流矢死，都藍繼位，到599年都藍敗亡被部下所殺，隋冊啟民可汗，603年達頭可汗也敗。回頭看，583年這一仗真正贏的不是某一場會戰，而是一種主動權：從此草原的進退，要看中原的冊封與分化，而不是看牙帳裡誰的弓射得準。
resultEn: The counter-stroke of 583 did not destroy Shabulo; it ended in a different form: it beat him into asking for peace and forced the khanate to tear itself apart. On the military side there was a clear Sui success at the White Way, where Shabulo escaped with his life alone and ran to the Qikou, while on the Liangzhou road Dou Rongding beat Aboshi several times at Gao Yuanyuan, and the khan for the first time had to acknowledge the weight of the Central Plain's arms. On the diplomatic side the Sui court did not press on into the northern desert to take the khan alive, but turned instead to the system of hostages and titles: in the late winter of 583 Shabulo sent an envoy to ask for peace and the princess offered herself to take the Sui surname, in 584 she was re-titled the Grand Princess of Virtue, and in the seventh month of 585 the khan declared himself a vassal, and the north bought sixteen years without any large-scale southward raid, leaving the Sui free to throw its whole weight southward. Internally the khanate came apart: Shabulo had seized Aboshi's northern camp and killed his mother, and paid for it with Tatuo's counter-stroke of more than a hundred thousand riders, gathering tens of thousands of scattered men and winning repeatedly; Shabulo died in 587, Chuluohou succeeded him and took Aboshi alive, the Mohe khan was killed by an arrow in 588 and Dulun followed, and by 599 Dulun had been destroyed and killed by his own men, the Sui enfeoffed the Qimin khan, and in 603 the khanate of Tatuo was beaten as well. Looking back, what the campaign of 583 truly won was not any single engagement but a kind of initiative: from then on whether the steppe went forward or back was decided by the enfeoffments and the divisions worked at the Chinese court, and not by whose bow shot truer in the tented headquarters.
